# Portrait layout for Herdr

> A Herdr layout for vertical (portrait) monitors: spaces as columns with a tab and pane tree and agent states, a strip with a needs-you bell, a Files side panel with a floating nvim, and a tab bar. Two layouts and the mods they need. Apache-2.0. No network use.

Install by telling a Herdr agent: install https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/README.md): what it is, install by agent and by hand, keys, requirements, privacy, troubleshooting, uninstall.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an agent installs, adapts, tests and edits this repository safely.
- [RECIPE.md](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/RECIPE.md): the build brief in Herdr's six-section format.

## Reference

- [Privacy and side effects](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/docs/privacy.html): what each mod reads, runs and writes.
- [Platforms](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/docs/platforms.html): macOS, Linux, Windows.
- [Usage](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/docs/usage.html) and [Configuration](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/docs/configuration.html): what each part does; theme, sizes, keys, Vault panel.
- [How it works](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.html): layout tree, mods, shared state, provenance.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.html)

## Files

- [layouts/portrait.json](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/layouts/portrait.json) and [layouts/portrait-bottom.json](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/layouts/portrait-bottom.json): the two layouts.
- [keys.json](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/keys.json): keys to merge into the person's own.
- [mods/](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/tree/main/mods): bar-strip, portrait-tree, portrait-tabs, portrait-pane, portrait-files, nvim-float, attention-picker (bundled copy).
- [snippets/vault-panel.json](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/snippets/vault-panel.json): optional Vault panel node.
